findings.claim: The PSO Fuzzy XGBoost classifier framework integrates a Neural-Gas Network (NGN) for feature extraction with Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) and fuzzy logic for hyperparameter tuning and decision optimization.

evidence.source_text: This study explores the integration of Neural-Gas Network (NGN), XGBoost, Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO), and fuzzy logic to enhance emotion recognition using physiological signals.

findings.approach: Integration of NGN feature extraction with PSO-optimized fuzzy XGBoost classification
findings.architecture: Neural-Gas Network (NGN) and PSO Fuzzy XGBoost

findings.claim: The Dual Attentive (DuA) transformer architecture processes full long-term EEG trials using spatial-spectral, temporal, and transfer learning modules.

evidence.source_text: The DuA transformer incorporates three key modules: the spatial-spectral network module, the temporal network module, and the transfer learning module.

findings.approach: Trial-based long-term continuous EEG emotion analysis using Dual Attentive Transformer

findings.claim: The Emotion Transformer (EmT) architecture combines a Temporal Graph Construction (TGC) module, a Residual Multi-view Pyramid GCN (RMPG) module, a Temporal Contextual Transformer (TCT) module, and a Task-Specific Output (TSO) module.

evidence.source_text: In EmT, EEG signals are transformed into a temporal graph format... A novel residual multi-view pyramid GCN module (RMPG) is then proposed... Furthermore, we design a temporal contextual transformer module (TCT)... Finally, the task-specific output module (TSO) generates the desired outputs.

findings.approach: Dynamic graph representation learning and temporal contextual transformers for cross-subject EEG emotion decoding
findings.architecture: Emotion Transformer (EmT) with GCN and Transformer modules

findings.claim: Four variant Transformer architectures—spatial attention, temporal attention, sequential spatial-temporal attention, and simultaneous spatial-temporal attention—were designed for EEG emotion recognition, with simultaneous spatial-temporal attention performing best.

evidence.source_text: This work proposes four variant transformer frameworks~(spatial attention, temporal attention, sequential spatial-temporal attention and simultaneous spatial-temporal attention) for EEG emotion recognition

findings.approach: Spatial-temporal Transformer variants for EEG emotion recognition
findings.architecture: Spatial-temporal Transformer (simultaneous, sequential, spatial, and temporal variants)

findings.claim: CIT-EmotionNet combines a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) and Transformer in parallel with an interactive module to extract local and global features from spatial-frequency EEG representations.

evidence.source_text: we integrate Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) and Transformer within a single framework in a parallel manner. Finally, we design a CNN interactive Transformer module

findings.approach: Parallel CNN-Transformer interaction for joint local and global spatial-frequency feature fusion

findings.claim: The Fourier Adjacency Transformer architecture integrates Fourier-inspired periodic feature extraction modules with an adjacency attention graph scheme.

evidence.source_text: Our method first leverages novel Fourier-inspired modules to extract periodic features from embedded EEG signals, effectively decoupling them from aperiodic components. Subsequently, we employ an adjacency attention scheme to reinforce universal inter-channel correlation patterns

findings.approach: Fourier periodic feature decoupling combined with graph-driven adjacency attention

findings.claim: A Transformer architecture utilizing channel weight-shared temporal feature extractors and multi-head self-attention adaptively captures temporal dynamics and spatial correlations in EEG signals.

evidence.source_text: temporal feature extractors which share the weight among all the EEG channels are designed to adaptively extract dynamic context information from raw signals. Furthermore, multi-head self-attention mechanism within the transformers could adaptively localize the vital EEG fragments

findings.approach: Temporal-spatial representation learning via weight-shared temporal feature extractors and multi-head self-attention Transformer
findings.architecture: Transformer with channel weight-shared temporal feature extractors

findings.claim: The Attention-based Multiple Dimensions EEG Transformer (AMDET) employs a 3D temporal-spectral-spatial input representation processed by a spectral-spatial transformer encoder layer and a temporal attention layer.

evidence.source_text: We transformed the original EEG data into 3D temporal-spectral-spatial representations and then the AMDET would use spectral-spatial transformer encoder layer to extract effective features in the EEG signal and concentrate on the critical time frame with a temporal attention layer.

findings.approach: Multi-dimensional global attention on 3D temporal-spectral-spatial EEG representations

findings.claim: A 3D Convolutional Neural Network (3D CNN) architecture classifies EEG emotions using spatial-temporal-spectral representations generated from Multivariate Empirical Mode Decomposition (MEMD) and Marginal Hilbert Spectrum (MHS).

evidence.source_text: A 3D convolutional neural network (CNN) is adopted to perform emotion detection with spatial-temporal-spectral feature representations that are constructed by stacking the multi-channel MHS over consecutive signal segments.

findings.approach: MEMD-HHT feature extraction coupled with 3D CNN classification

findings.claim: Deep Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) extract spatiotemporal features from EEG signals across varying window sizes and electrode orderings for emotion recognition.

evidence.source_text: In this work, a study of CNN and its spatiotemporal feature extraction has been conducted in order to explore capabilities of the model in varied window sizes and electrode orders.

findings.approach: Spatiotemporal EEG feature extraction using deep CNNs across different window sizes

findings.claim: The EEG-based Emotion Style Transfer Network (E2STN) consists of a transfer module, a transfer evaluation module, and a discriminative prediction module to enable cross-dataset emotion recognition.

evidence.source_text: E2STN consists of three modules, i.e., transfer module, transfer evaluation module, and discriminative prediction module.

findings.approach: Style transfer network to align source emotional content and target statistical characteristics
